en.name: Cajun seasoning blend
en.summary: Cajun seasoning keeps 1–2 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard — a shorter window than a single spice like cinnamon, because a blend is only as good as its most fragile component. It fades rather than spoils.
en.pantry: 1–2 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and dry. A Cajun blend is typically paprika, cayenne, garlic and onion powder, black and white pepper and dried herbs, and those parts fade at very different rates: the dried oregano and thyme go first, the paprika loses its colour in light, and the salt in most commercial blends draws moisture and cakes the lot. Keep it away from the hob, and out of daylight, which bleaches the red pigment noticeably within months.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for Cajun seasoning. A salted ground blend in a humid fridge cakes quickly and takes on other smells, so the cupboard is where it belongs. If your kitchen is very humid and you want to protect the colour, a properly airtight jar and a full return to room temperature before opening are the minimum precautions.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Cold would slow the pigment and aroma loss, but condensation every time the jar comes out is a worse problem for a salty blend that already cakes. Buying small and making your own from whole spices you toast and grind is a more useful answer than the freezer.
en.thawing: Not applicable — Cajun seasoning is a dry cupboard blend and should not be frozen.
spoilage: A faded orange-brown colour where the blend was brick red.
Little or no smell when you warm a pinch in your palm.
Hard lumps, which mean the salt has pulled in moisture.
Mould inside a lump, or a musty smell, in a jar that got damp.
tips: Use an opaque jar or a dark cupboard; paprika and cayenne bleach in daylight.
Use a dry spoon; the salt in the blend makes it cake at the first hint of moisture.
Bloom it in the pan in a little oil before adding liquid, to wake the aroma up.
Make small batches yourself if you want it to taste of something specific.

faq.q: How long does Cajun seasoning keep?
faq.a: 1–2 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Why do spice blends keep less well than single spices?
faq.a: A blend is limited by its most fragile component. Dried herbs and ground chilli fade much faster than something like cinnamon or nutmeg.
No, just dull. Ground blends fade rather than spoil. Only a caked, damp jar with visible mould should be thrown out.

zh.name: 卡疆綜合香料
zh.summary: 卡疆香料自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 1～2 年——比肉桂這類單一香料短，因為一個綜合香料的壽命，取決於裡面最脆弱的那個成分。它是淡掉，不是腐敗。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 1～2 年。卡疆香料典型的組成是紅椒粉、卡宴辣椒、蒜粉與洋蔥粉、黑白胡椒，加上乾燥香草，而這些成分退場的速度差很多：乾燥的奧勒岡和百里香最先走，紅椒粉在光線下會褪色，而多數市售配方裡的鹽又會把水氣吸過來、讓整罐結塊。請遠離爐台、避免日光——日光在幾個月內就會明顯把紅色素漂淡。
zh.fridge: 卡疆香料沒有公布的冷藏期限。一個含鹽的研磨綜合香料放進潮濕的冰箱，會很快結塊，也會吸進別的味道，所以它該待的地方是櫥櫃。如果廚房非常潮濕、而你想保住顏色，那麼「真正氣密的罐子」加上「完全回溫再打開」是最起碼的防護。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。低溫確實能拖慢色素與香氣流失，但對一個本來就容易結塊的含鹽配方來說，每次拿出來的結露是更大的問題。買少量，或乾脆自己用整粒香料烘香現磨，都比冷凍有用。
zh.thawing: 不適用——卡疆香料是乾燥的櫥櫃綜合香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 原本磚紅的顏色退成暗淡的橘褐色。
在手心搓熱一小撮，幾乎聞不到香氣。
出現硬塊，代表鹽把水氣吸進來了。
受潮的罐子，硬塊裡看得到霉或有霉味。
tips: 用不透光的罐子或收進暗櫃；紅椒粉和卡宴辣椒在日光下會褪色。
用乾湯匙；配方裡的鹽一碰到水氣就會結塊。
加液體之前先用一點油在鍋裡炒香，把香氣叫醒。
想要味道明確一點，就自己少量現調。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 1～2 年。

faq.q: 為什麼綜合香料比單一香料不耐放？
faq.a: 綜合香料受限於裡面最脆弱的成分。乾燥香草和辣椒粉退得比肉桂或肉豆蔻快得多。

faq.q: 放久的卡疆香料有危險嗎？
faq.a: 沒有，只是變得平淡。研磨綜合香料是淡掉而不是腐敗。只有受潮結塊、看得到霉的才該丟。
